claim: For dynamic routing, the BGP ASN of a customer gateway can be in the range 1–4,294,967,295 (some public ASNs such as 7224 are reserved). Without a public ASN you can use a private ASN in the range 64,512–65,534 or 4,200,000,000–4,294,967,294. The default ASN is 64512.
question: Which private ASN ranges can a Site-to-Site VPN customer gateway use, and what is the default ASN?

qualifiers.scope: customer gateway BGP ASN, dynamic routing only
qualifiers.condition: you can use your own public ASN instead, except the reserved ones

note: register-12: added from the customer gateway options page. It replaces site-to-site-vpn-faq-cgw-32bit-private-asn-unsupported (VPN FAQ item 119 says the 32-bit private range is not supported; the guide page says it can be used; the guide is current). d12-007, d12-060.
